title: Small accessibility fixes: anchor offset, footer and card headings, 44px menu button, live reduced-motion (SCAN-1029)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. Public pages get scroll-padding-top equal to the fixed header plus 16px so focus and anchor jumps clear it (2.4.11). Footer column titles and the Help front-page card titles are headings in the outline. The menu sheet footer button is 44px. site-fx listens for the reduced-motion setting changing and re-decorates the page at once.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];if(!r('app/themes/frequency/kit-site.css').includes('scroll-padding-top'))bad.push('no scroll padding under the fixed header');if(!r('components/frequency/site/shell/site-footer.tsx').includes('role=\"heading\"'))bad.push('footer columns are not headings');if(!r('components/frequency/site/shell/site-fx.tsx').includes(\"addEventListener('change'\"))bad.push('reduced motion is read once');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1029: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the header offset, footer headings or the live reduced-motion listener disappear.
